errors.detail: ContactFlow has contactCompartment=//@compartments.1 and target=//@compartments.1. These should be different compartments. ContactFlow moves source to target upon contact with contactCompartment.
Compartment 'Susceptible' has population=0 and no incoming flow or externalSource. Susceptible compartments typically need recruitment.
All 6 compartments have population=0. This indicates a critical extraction failure.

outgoing_flows.description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious people, deceased people, and environmental pathogens at rates ψ1, ψ3, ψ2 respectively
Infected people entering quarantine at rate ρ3
Shedding of pathogens by infected humans into the environment at rate ρ2
Recovery of quarantined individuals at rate w1

parameters.name: α1
parameters.description: The proportion at which susceptible people are recruited

parameters.name: α2
parameters.description: The proportion at which infected people are recruited

parameters.name: ψ1
parameters.description: The rate of contact (effective) of infected human

parameters.name: ψ2
parameters.description: The rate of contact of Ebola virus pathogens in the environment

parameters.name: ρ1
parameters.description: Rate of deaths of human individuals due to infection

parameters.name: ρ2
parameters.description: Rate at which shedding of infected humans

parameters.name: ρ3
parameters.description: The rate at which infected people quarantined

parameters.name: w1
parameters.description: The rate at which quarantined people are recovered

parameters.name: w2
parameters.description: The rate at which quarantine people are in deceased

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Proportion of shedding of deceased people

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: The proportion rate of burial deceased people

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: The rate at which EVD in the environment decays

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Additional input of pathogens into the environment
